goals.objective: Review the FrameTrace codebase and current roadmap/progress end-to-end without code changes. Analyze current implementation, docs, ULW evidence, tests, release posture, and remaining work. Deliver an evidence-backed code review, progress assessment, deficiency analysis, and ordered remaining-step plan. Tier: HEAVY because the user requested 전체 code review/progress analysis across architecture, security, QA, release readiness, and prior ULW evidence. Success criteria: C001 code review evidence from repository files and fresh static/test commands; C002 progress/readiness assessment from docs, plans, ULW ledgers, git history, and release gates; C003 ordered remaining-stage plan with blockers, owners, validation evidence, and no unsupported Windows/WinUI GA claim.
